module_summary: 10G Ethernet MAC+PHY receive path: a 10GBASE-R PHY RX interface descrambles and block-syncs SERDES data into encoded 64b/66b blocks, which a BASE-R decoder frames into AXI-Stream packets.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data
anchors.why: Raw 64-bit SERDES receive data into the PHY RX interface.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: 64b/66b sync header from SERDES.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip request to SERDES from block-sync logic.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: Watchdog SERDES reset request output.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data
anchors.why: Descrambled encoded block data linking PHY interface to BASE-R decoder.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Encoded block header passed from PHY interface to decoder.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Decoded AXI-Stream packet data output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-valid mask of output word.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Error/timestamp sideband of output stream.

anchors.name: rx_block_lock

anchors.name: rx_status

anchors.name: rx_high_ber

groups.name: phy_rx_interface
